facts.claim: Disney Adventure (Disney Cruise Line): Entered service 2026; 208,108 GT; 6000 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 341 m length; Global class.
Disney Adventure is a cruise ship owned and operated by Disney Cruise Line, a subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company.
She is the eighth ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet and the first and only current vessel of the Global class, with her originally planned sister ship canceled.
At 208,108 gross tonnage (GT), Disney Adventure is one of the largest cruise ships in the world and the largest cruise ship ever built in Germany.

catalogSpecs.description: Global-class ship (ex-Genting); entered service March 2026, homeported year-round in Singapore.
